data.one_liner: Pick emojis, stickers, or GIFs from Giphy in pure Dart code.
data.what_it_does: Allows users to search, browse, and pick emojis, stickers, and GIFs directly from Giphy using its API. Includes customizable loading states, progressive loading, and UI wrappers or standalone widgets.
use_when: You want to integrate Giphy search and selection into your app
You need a ready-to-use widget to display GIFs with Giphy attribution guidelines
avoid_when: You need a general-purpose image picker for device photos
You do not have a Giphy API key
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, Web, and Desktop
Batch and progressive loading for optimized network and memory usage
Includes localization support for multiple languages
weaknesses: Requires registration and an API key from Giphy Developers
data.setup_notes: Register an app at Giphy Developers to obtain an API key, and configure GiphyGetUILocalizations in your MaterialApp delegates.
data.minimal_example: GiphyGif gif = await GiphyGet.getGif(context: context, apiKey: "your api key HERE");
